title: YieldNodes begins operating
description: YieldNodes states that it established its managed masternode-rental and staking operation around 2019.
notes: The exact launch day was not identified; 1 January is a sortable approximate date based on a later first-party status statement.

title: YieldNodes suspends new deposits
description: YieldNodes says it stopped accepting deposits after an exchange-account freeze and liquidity pressure made continued inflows incompatible with its stated operating model.
notes: The causal explanation is the operator's account and is not treated as independently proven.

title: YieldNodes suspends withdrawals
description: YieldNodes halted withdrawals and pending payments; affected users later organized a separate recovery and legal effort concerning frozen principal.
notes: First-party and affected-investor sources agree that withdrawals stopped, but differ on legal characterization and responsibility.

title: YieldNodes enters restructuring
description: The operator proposed replacing ordinary account liquidity with a restructuring tied to DECENOMY assets and a future economic platform.
notes: The plan is recorded as an operator proposal, not as proof of asset value or successful recovery.

title: YieldNodes begins account-linked NFT distribution
description: YieldNodes announced that NFTs representing specific customer accounts were ready for distribution and could be self-custodied or transferred.
notes: NFT issuance is not classified as repayment and no market or repurchase value is inferred.

title: YieldNodes NFT claim window closes
description: YieldNodes states that the account-linked NFT claiming phase ended on 31 December 2023, followed by reissuance work after a reported smart-contract vulnerability.
notes: Claiming or holding an NFT does not establish recovery completion or a verified repurchase value.

title: YieldNodes Pro remains contingent on regulatory resolution
description: A first-party status update says the proposed YieldNodes Pro launch remains dependent on unresolved regulatory issues and continued restructuring work.
notes: The update does not establish a launch date, restored withdrawals, or completed recovery.

title: Cake DeFi begins operating
description: Cake DeFi was founded in 2019 to provide retail access to crypto yield and decentralized-finance services.
notes: The exact launch day was not identified; 1 January is a sortable approximate date.

title: Cake DeFi documents staking, lending, and liquidity-mining products
description: Cake DeFi described a product suite spanning staking, institutional-partner lending, and DeFiChain liquidity mining for customer yield generation.
notes: Historical product descriptions and advertised rates are not treated as current or guaranteed.

title: Cake DeFi retail platform rebrands to Bake
description: Cake Group announced that the Cake DeFi retail business and mobile applications would adopt the Bake name while the wider group retained separate institutional, research, and venture activities.
notes: The record treats Cake DeFi and Bake as one continuing retail-platform identity, not two separate canonical platforms.

title: Bake announces indefinite suspension of crypto-asset services
description: Bake announced that crypto-asset trading services would be suspended from 15 April 2026 as part of MiCA alignment, with withdrawals available before the cutoff and remaining balances to be converted to USD.
notes: The company described the step as a business decision during regulatory transition rather than an enforcement order.

title: Bake blocks crypto services and converts balances to USD
description: Updated platform terms restricted Bake to maintaining existing accounts and processing withdrawals of USD balances converted at the 15 April 2026 exchange rate; crypto trading, storage, deposits, new accounts, and other crypto functionality were blocked.
notes: The platform remains available for account maintenance and USD withdrawals, so the canonical platform status is limited rather than fully operations-ended.
